g.text: DIO_A (pin 1) is ALWAYS the host's driving line: UART TX, I2C SCL, SPI MOSI.

g.desc: DIO_A (pin 1) is ALWAYS the host's driving line: UART TX, I2C SCL, SPI MOSI.

g.text: ▎ DIO_B (pin 4) is the host's input: UART RX, I2C SDA, SPI MISO. No exceptions

g.desc: ▎ DIO_B (pin 4) is the host's input: UART RX, I2C SDA, SPI MISO. No exceptions

g.text: ▎ on any pyControl breakout. So DIO_A = this board's RX.

g.desc: ▎ on any pyControl breakout. So DIO_A = this board's RX.

g.text: ▎ Breakout 1.2 UART ports: 1 (UART4), 3 (USART1), 4 (USART3). I2C only on 3, 4.

g.desc: ▎ Breakout 1.2 UART ports: 1 (UART4), 3 (USART1), 4 (USART3). I2C only on 3, 4.

g.text: ▎ H7 breakout UART ports: 1,2,3,4,5,9,10. I2C on 1, 6. SPI on 7, 8.

g.desc: ▎ H7 breakout UART ports: 1,2,3,4,5,9,10. I2C on 1, 6. SPI on 7, 8.

g.text: ▎ GPIOB6-13, no ADC channel). Port 6 DIO_B is the same net as BNC-2.

g.desc: ▎ GPIOB6-13, no ADC channel). Port 6 DIO_B is the same net as BNC-2.

g.text: ▎ DIO_C (pin 5) is NOT 5V tolerant where it is a DAC (PA4/PA5). DIO_A/DIO_B are FT.

g.desc: ▎ DIO_C (pin 5) is NOT 5V tolerant where it is a DAC (PA4/PA5). DIO_A/DIO_B are FT.
